tracks.title: Title theme
tracks.prompt: Title-screen theme for a zombie-survival game set in a dark forest ringed by mountains, an instrumental metal and chiptune hybrid in the style of early-1990s PC shooter soundtracks brought up to date: drop-tuned palm-muted rhythm guitars and a modern heavy mix, with a bright FM-synthesis lead (the sound of an old PC sound card) and 8-bit square-wave arpeggios. 72 BPM, D dorian. Opens on a lone FM-synth melody over a low drone; a clean guitar answers, then the distorted guitars and drums land for a big, memorable hook in the middle; it winds back down to the drone so it can loop. Ominous, proud, unhurried. No vocals.

tracks.title: Day prep
tracks.prompt: Daytime building-and-scavenging music for a zombie-survival game, an instrumental metal and chiptune hybrid in the style of early-1990s PC shooter soundtracks brought up to date: drop-tuned palm-muted rhythm guitars and a modern heavy mix, with a bright FM-synthesis lead (the sound of an old PC sound card) and 8-bit square-wave arpeggios, but laid back: clean and lightly overdriven guitars, a walking bass, soft square-wave arpeggios and a gentle FM lead. 96 BPM, G dorian. Hopeful but uneasy, never fully relaxed. Mid-tempo groove that stays in the background, steady from start to end so it loops. No vocals.

tracks.title: Morning
tracks.prompt: Early-morning music after surviving the night, an instrumental metal and chiptune hybrid in the style of early-1990s PC shooter soundtracks brought up to date: drop-tuned palm-muted rhythm guitars and a modern heavy mix, with a bright FM-synthesis lead (the sound of an old PC sound card) and 8-bit square-wave arpeggios, quiet version: a slow FM-synth melody, chiming square-wave arpeggios, a clean guitar with long delay, sparse soft drums. 84 BPM, E minor. Tired relief with a little dread underneath. Even level throughout so it loops. No vocals.
tracks.usedFor: Morning, the first hour of the day

tracks.title: Dusk
tracks.prompt: Dusk music: the light is going and the horde is coming, an instrumental metal and chiptune hybrid in the style of early-1990s PC shooter soundtracks brought up to date: drop-tuned palm-muted rhythm guitars and a modern heavy mix, with a bright FM-synthesis lead (the sound of an old PC sound card) and 8-bit square-wave arpeggios. 80 BPM, A phrygian. A low, slow palm-muted chug under a mournful FM lead, a ticking hi-hat, eerie square-wave pulses, the tension slowly building but never exploding. Steady level so it loops. No vocals.

tracks.title: Night prep
tracks.prompt: Night-time waiting music between attacks, an instrumental metal and chiptune hybrid in the style of early-1990s PC shooter soundtracks brought up to date: drop-tuned palm-muted rhythm guitars and a modern heavy mix, with a bright FM-synthesis lead (the sound of an old PC sound card) and 8-bit square-wave arpeggios, dark and restrained: a deep drone, slow heavy guitar swells, a lonely FM-synth melody and a faint square-wave heartbeat pulse, half-time drums that come and go. 84 BPM, G minor. tracks.title: Aftermath
